name: Emissive Clip Planes
definition: A technique that solves two illumination problems when cutting through a volume: random lighting caused by noisy gradients in homogeneous materials, and dark back-facing surfaces revealed by clipping. It overrides lighting parameters immediately adjacent to the clip plane with purely emissive illumination.
summary: Emissive Clip Planes eliminate visual artifacts at clipped volume boundaries by applying purely emissive coloring to adjacent samples, preserving material appearance and specular highlights elsewhere.
